TODAY
Rebuilt from src/ at exact values, with the real project logos.

The problems: no hierarchy past the name, three icon cards that say almost nothing, no experience section, and no way to contact you.

Also worth fixing whichever design wins: Todo App and Currency Conversion API both use the generic GitHub logo as their thumbnail.

EDITORIAL INK — the direction we're building
Warm paper, ink, one accent. Instrument Serif + Instrument Sans + JetBrains Mono.

All seven projects sit in one numbered list at equal weight, each with its real logo in a bordered square. Experience and Contact are new sections, both drawn from your CV — say the word if you'd rather drop either.

The accent is a tweak chip above this frame; one of the swatches is your current indigo.
